# Panorama from the sensor (#093 / #096) — every sequence, default vs rule

*Generated by `scripts/table_panorama_rule.py` from `kiss_runs/results_official_allarms_093b.csv` (2/10/2026). Default = `base092` (after_091: upright SURF, guided matching, two starts, range fallback; panorama 1024 × 8). Rule = `autowh093` (columns of the sensor, square pixels, measured from the first scan; NCD 2021: `up2093`, 1024 × 2). Mean ± sd over 4 seeds per sequence; Δ = (rule − default) / default. Official protocol of each dataset (evo for Spires / NCD; Hilti and NTU: their own score in the APE row, other rows empty). Lower is better everywhere (path: |excess|). ⏳ not validated.*
